editorialSummary.heading: What CFISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: Three separate five-day breaks in fall, Thanksgiving week, and spring
A continuous winter no-class period from December 21 through January 4
Three student holidays that may be used as school-closure make-up days
paragraphs: For students, CFISD's 2026-2027 school year runs from Wednesday, August 12, to Thursday, May 27. The calendar includes five-day fall, Thanksgiving and spring breaks, plus a longer winter break from December 21 through January 1. January 4 is a professional day and student holiday, so classes resume Tuesday, January 5.

Other districtwide no-class dates include Labor Day on September 7, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, professional days on January 4, February 15, and April 26, and a separate student/staff holiday on March 26. Elementary and secondary schools use the same four grading-period ranges on the district calendar.

Unlike ordinary student holidays, October 9, November 3, and March 12 are also reserved as school-closure make-up days. Under the published schedule, students are off on all three dates; October 9 and March 12 are also designated as inclement-weather make-up days. Families should recheck CFISD notices before relying on these dates for travel or child care.

comparativeInsights: Fall break and spring break each contain five consecutive weekdays with no classes.
Winter break ends January 1, but the adjacent January 4 professional day extends the practical no-class period through Monday.
October 9, November 3, and March 12 are not unconditional days off because the calendar also reserves them as school-closure make-up dates.
Elementary and secondary schools share the same four grading-period ranges on the district PDF.
The district PDF does not identify any districtwide early-release dates, parent conferences, or report-card dates.

about.dataSource: This page is based on Cypress-Fairbanks ISD's one-page 2026-2027 District Calendar PDF, the district calendar page, and the Board's calendar-approval announcement, checked through October 4, 2026. Together they provide the student-year boundaries, official break names, professional days, conditional make-up dates, and grading periods.
about.processing: The PDF legend and Important Dates column were read with the Board announcement. Student-facing closures during the regular year are included, while August professional days before the first student day and the May 28 professional day after the last student day are omitted. Conditional make-up dates are treated as no-school dates under the published calendar but may become attendance days if CFISD activates them.
about.updates: CFISD may activate a reserved make-up date after a weather or school closure, or issue a revised PDF. Recheck the official calendar page and district announcements before relying on October 9, November 3, or March 12 for travel or child care.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference is not operated by Cypress-Fairbanks ISD. Confirm schedule changes, make-up day decisions, bell times, transportation, testing, and campus-specific events with CFISD or your child's school.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for CFISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 12, 2026. The district calendar lists August 3-11 as professional days before students begin classes.

faqs.question: What is the last day of school for Cypress-Fairbanks ISD?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Friday, May 28 is a professional day after the student year ends.

faqs.question: When is CFISD fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: CFISD fall break runs Monday, October 12, through Friday, October 16, 2026. Students return Monday, October 19.

faqs.question: When is CFISD Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Classes resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is CFISD winter break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Winter break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a professional day, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: When is CFISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: CFISD spring break runs Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Which CFISD dates may be used as school-closure make-up days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: October 9, November 3, and March 12 are listed as student holidays and school-closure make-up days. Under the published schedule, students have no regular classes on those dates. October 9 and March 12 are also designated as inclement-weather make-up days. Check CFISD notices for any schedule change or make-up-day activation.

faqs.question: When are CFISD professional days with no school for students in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: During the student school year, CFISD has professional days with no student classes on January 4, February 15, and April 26, 2027. The district also lists professional days before students start school in August and on May 28 after the last student day.

faqs.question: Is there school in CFISD on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026, is Labor Day and a CFISD student/staff holiday.

faqs.question: Is there school in CFISD on Martin Luther King Jr. Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027, is Martin Luther King Jr. Day and a CFISD student/staff holiday.

faqs.question: Is there school in CFISD on March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, March 26, 2027, is a separate CFISD student/staff holiday.

faqs.question: What are the CFISD grading period dates for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: CFISD uses the same four grading-period ranges for elementary and secondary schools: August 12-October 8, October 19-December 18, January 5-March 11, and March 22-May 27.

faqs.question: When are CFISD early-release days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The one-page CFISD district calendar does not list any districtwide early-release dates. Families should check their child's campus communications for campus-specific dismissal changes.

faqs.question: When are CFISD parent-teacher conferences in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The districtwide 2026-2027 calendar does not list parent-teacher conference dates. Families should check their child's campus calendar or campus communications for school-specific dates.

faqs.question: When are CFISD report cards issued in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The districtwide calendar does not provide report-card issue dates. Families should check campus communications. CFISD's Home Access Center (HAC) is where parents can view grades and report cards once posted.

faqs.question: Does the CFISD district calendar apply to every school?
faqs.answer: These are districtwide dates from the CFISD District Calendar. Campus-specific testing, athletics, performances, and other events can vary by school.

faqs.question: Is there school in CFISD on October 9, 2026?
faqs.answer: No, under the currently published schedule. October 9 is a teacher work day and student holiday, but it is also reserved as a school-closure make-up day and is one of CFISD's designated inclement-weather make-up days. Families should check CFISD notices for any schedule change.

faqs.question: Is there school in CFISD on March 12, 2027?
faqs.answer: No, under the published schedule. March 12 is a teacher work day and student holiday, but it is also reserved as a school-closure make-up day and is one of CFISD's designated inclement-weather make-up days.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official CFISD 2026-2027 calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF link on this page or open the CFISD calendar page and select the 2026-27 District Calendar.

faqs.question: How can CFISD start school on August 12, before the fourth Monday in August?
faqs.answer: CFISD is a District of Innovation. The district says that status allows an exemption from the Texas rule that otherwise prevents instruction from starting before the fourth Monday in August.

statistics.label: Student attendance days
statistics.explanation: Calculated from 207 weekdays between the first and last student days, adjusting for 31 confirmed no-school weekdays, 3 conditional make-up weekdays currently listed without regular classes. The total will change if the district activates a make-up date.

statistics.label: Confirmed non-conditional no-school weekdays
statistics.explanation: Counted from confirmed districtwide no-class events between the first and last student days. Conditional make-up dates are excluded because they may become attendance days.

statistics.label: Confirmed standalone no-school days
statistics.explanation: Counts confirmed weekdays without regular classes outside holidays and multi-day breaks, including staff or planning days. Conditional make-up dates are excluded from this standalone count.

statistics.label: Longest listed break
statistics.explanation: Dec 19, 2026–Jan 4, 2027, including weekends. The stretch contains 11 confirmed no-school weekdays.

statistics.label: Long weekends
statistics.explanation: Counts three- or four-day no-school stretches formed by a weekend plus one or two confirmed weekday closures. Longer school breaks are excluded.

statistics.label: Full-week breaks
statistics.explanation: Counts continuous no-school stretches containing at least five confirmed weekdays without regular classes. Adjacent holidays and weekends remain part of the same break.
